lists.title: Choose task lists
lists.description: Each selected list becomes a to-do entity.

reconfigure.title: Update connection
reconfigure.description: Change the connection to {service}. Leave the password empty to keep the current one. Entity IDs are kept.

connect_caldav.title: Connect to a CalDAV server
connect_caldav.description: Enter the connection details for the account that owns the shared task list.

data_description.url: CalDAV root, for example {example_url}. Must start with https:// and must not contain a username or password.
data_description.password: Use an app-specific password where the service offers one (Nextcloud: Settings → Security; iCloud and Fastmail: account security settings).

error.invalid_url: Enter an https:// URL without a username, password, query or fragment.
error.invalid_auth: The service rejected the username or password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the server. Check the host name, DNS and that it is reachable from Home Assistant.
error.not_caldav: The server answered, but not like a CalDAV server. Check the URL (for Nextcloud it ends in /remote.php/dav).
error.no_task_lists: No task lists were found for this account.

abort.wrong_account: That is a different account; add it as a new integration instead.

data_description.assignees: Each person is stored on tasks as a tag (CATEGORIES) with this exact text, matching the phones' “My tasks” filters. Color is an optional #rrggbb for the card.

error.duplicate_assignee: Each person and each tag may only appear once.
error.cannot_connect_lists: Could not refresh the available task lists from the service; showing the current selection.

unknown_list.message: {list} is not a Family Tasks list.

unknown_task.message: No task with UID {uid} was found.

refresh_failed.message: Couldn't reach the task service. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

add_task.name: Add task
add_task.description: Add a task to a family list, assigned to one or more people.

assignees.name: Assignees
assignees.description: People to assign (must be configured in the options).

due_datetime.name: Due date and time
due_datetime.description: Due date with a time (Home Assistant's time zone).

update_task.name: Update task
update_task.description: Change a task. Only the given fields change; other tags and properties are kept.

assignees.name: Assignees
assignees.description: Replace all assignees with these people (empty list unassigns everyone).

due_datetime.name: Due date and time
due_datetime.description: Due date with a time (null clears).

complete_task.name: Complete task
complete_task.description: Mark a task done. Repeating tasks move to their next due date.

reopen_task.name: Reopen task
reopen_task.description: Mark a completed task as not done.

delete_task.name: Delete task
delete_task.description: Delete a task from the service.

get_tasks.name: Get tasks
get_tasks.description: Return tasks with assignees, tags, priority and repeat rule.

assignee.name: Assignee
assignee.description: Only tasks assigned to this person (or 'unassigned').

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Fetch the latest tasks from the service now, instead of waiting for the next poll.

list.name: List
list.description: Refresh the account this list is on. Leave empty to refresh every Family Tasks account.
